name: app-6a86dfe58e9c8191917c1d61c4fc91d4
description: Discover and enrich B2B companies and contacts using SMARTe.

interface.longDescription: Access SMARTe's verified B2B intelligence with 290M contacts across NAM, EMEA, and APAC using OpenAI. Discover companies that fit your ICP, enrich people and accounts with verified emails, direct dials, and mobile numbers, look up any company's tech stack or funding history - all in natural language.
defaultPrompt: Find SaaS companies in Germany with 501 to 1,000 employees.
Find any one Director-level engineering contact at Accenture.
Enrich a business contact Andrej Lehnert from Trivago.

positive.description: Get a full company profile from a website domain.
positive.expected_behavior: A firmographic profile of the company including: industry, employee range or count, revenue range, headquarter, NAICS/SIC classification, website, year founded, LinkedIn company URL, whatever information is available.

positive.description: Get a full person profile from name and company.
positive.expected_behavior: A person profile for the requested person including: current job title, seniority, department, LinkedIn URL, current employment status (job started on and updated on), work location, business email and direct dial if available.

positive.description: Discover companies that match an ICP filter.
positive.prompt: Find 2 companies in the United States with 501 to 1000 employees.
positive.expected_behavior: A list of matching companies with company name, employee headcount, revenue, location and company ID. Result set is scoped to the filter criteria provided in the prompt.

positive.description: Discover contacts that match a filter.
positive.prompt: Find a VP-and-above level contacts in RevOps at Vertafore.
positive.expected_behavior: A list of matching contacts with experience ID, job title, seniority, department, work country, company name, company country, company revenue range and company employee range if availble.

positive.description: Look up the technology stack a company uses.
positive.prompt: Find cloud platforms used by hubspot.com.
positive.expected_behavior: A list of technology stack (products) installed at the given company. The results are within categories related to cloud along with vendor names, as requested in the prompt.

negative.description: When a required identifier is missing or enough context is not provided.
The model refuses to invoke any out of scope request.
negative.prompt: Send an email to john.doe@salesforce.com telling him we should meet.

negative.description: Do not perform unsupported destructive account operations
negative.prompt: Delete every contact and company in my SMARTe account.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: SMARTe MCP v1.0 is the initial release of SMARTe's B2B data platform as a Model Context Protocol server, giving AI hosts like ChatGPT direct access to account discovery, contact search, and company/contact enrichment in-conversation. The release ships seven tools: search_companies and search_contacts for targeted discovery; enrich_company for firmographic profiles; enrich_person and enrich_mobile for contact details including business email, direct dial, and mobile; enrich_technographics for tech-stack lookup; and enrich_funding for funding history.
